map.经典数字华容道，滑动方块还原顺序。支持数字与图片两种模式。: Classic number sliding puzzle (Klondike / 15-puzzle): slide tiles to restore order. Supports number and image modes.
map.点击或方向键移动方块 · 将数字按顺序排列即可获胜: Click or use arrow keys to move a tile · arrange the numbers in order to win
map.游戏介绍与玩法说明: Game intro and how to play
map.滑动拼图（Sliding Puzzle）又称数字华容道或十五拼图，是一种经典的益: The Sliding Puzzle, also called the number Klondike or 15-puzzle, is a classic brain game. You slide tiles to rearrange the scrambled numbers from small to large.
map.点击空格相邻的方块进行滑动: Click a tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it
map.使用键盘方向键控制: Use keyboard arrow keys to control
map.将所有数字按顺序排列，空格在右下角: Arrange all numbers in order with the empty space at bottom-right
map.步数越少、用时越短，成绩越好: Fewer steps and less time mean a better score
map.切换到图片模式后，可以上传自定义图片或使用默认图片。图片会被切割成拼图块，你需要: After switching to image mode you can upload a custom image or use the default. The image is cut into tiles and you slide them to restore the full picture.
map.先还原第一行，再逐行向下: Restore the first row first, then go row by row downward
map.最后两行使用特殊技巧配合还原: Use special techniques for the last two rows
map.避免反复移动已归位的方块: Avoid moving already-placed tiles back and forth
map.从角落开始逐步向中心收拢: Start from a corner and work toward the center
map.思维训练：滑动方块还原 1~n 顺序。: Mind training: slide tiles to restore the 1~n order.
map.双模式：数字或图片拼图。: Two modes: number or image puzzle.
map.休闲挑战：比最少步数。: Casual challenge: compete on fewest steps.
map.点击与空格相邻的块滑入空格，逐步把数字按顺序排好（左上到右下，末格空）。合法打乱: Click a tile next to the empty space to slide into it, gradually ordering the numbers (top-left to bottom-right, last cell empty). A legal shuffle is always solvable; use the layer strategy 'restore first row and column first'.
map.3×3（8 数码）打乱后还原，最少步数依打乱深度（常见 20~30 步）；4×4: After shuffling a 3×3 (8-puzzle), the minimum steps depend on shuffle depth (commonly 20~30); a 4×4 (15-puzzle) gets much harder. Fix the first row/column first then shrink inward, avoiding back-and-forth moves.
map.用「随机合法滑动」生成的局面必有解；若直接随机置换则约半数无解，本工具保证可解。: A layout generated by random legal slides is always solvable; a direct random permutation is about half unsolvable, but this tool guarantees solvability.
map.分层还原：先第一行/列，再第二层，最后处理角，比盲目滑高效。: Layer by layer: first row/column, then the next layer, then corners—more efficient than blind sliding.
